transcript: Speaker A: भैया गलती से मेरा card अटक गया है। अब क्या करूँ? रहने दो आप, छोड़ो। आपको थोड़ी ना English के instructions समझ में आएंगे। [Brother, my card is stuck by mistake. What do I do now? Let it be, leave it. You won't understand English instructions anyway.] Speaker B: Absolutely ma'am. Let me help you with your card. Speaker A: भैया, card निकालने से पहले ये बता दो कि ये अंग्रेजी कहाँ से सीखी? [Brother, before taking out the card, tell me where did you learn this English?] Speaker B: वो तो English Seekho app का कमाल है। [That's the magic of the English Seekho app.] Speaker A: एक app से इतनी English सीख ली? [Learned so much English from just one app?] Speaker B: हाँ, उसके videos इतने मजेदार हैं कि मुझे लगा ही नहीं कि मैं कुछ पढ़ाई कर रहा हूँ। हँसते-खेलते सीख गया सब कुछ। [Yes, its videos are so fun that I didn't even feel like I was studying. Learned everything while playing and laughing.] Speaker A: और बोलने का confidence कैसे आया? [And how did the confidence to speak come?] Speaker B: वो भी English Seekho की कृपा है। असल में उसमें AI के साथ practice करके मेरे जैसे लाखों लोग confidently अंग्रेजी बोलना सीख रहे हैं। AI कभी मेरी गलती पर नहीं हँसती, बल्कि मेरी दोस्त बन के मुझे practice करवाती है। [That is also thanks to English Seekho. Actually, by practicing with AI in it, lakhs of people like me are learning to speak English confidently. AI never laughs at my mistakes, instead it becomes my friend and helps me practice.] Speaker A: और इतनी महंगाई में इस app के पैसे कहाँ से लाते हो? [And in this inflation, where do you get the money for this app?] Speaker B: महंगाई का app से क्या लेना-देना? ₹1 में तीन दिन का trial ले लो। अभी install button पर click करो और मेरी तरह फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करो। [What does inflation have to do with the app? Take a 3-day trial for ₹1. Click on the install button now and start speaking fluent English like me.] Speaker C: Install Now पे क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]

summary: A woman at an ATM is surprised when a security guard speaks fluent English to help her. He explains he learned it easily using the English Seekho app's interactive videos and AI practice feature. The ad promotes a 3-day trial for 1 rupee and urges viewers to install the app.
